subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should maintainers split Feishu outbound hook parity from normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening, and should the outbound fix be Feishu-local or a shared core hook-composition change?
rationale: The outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but `inbound_claim` controls pre-routing claim authority and a shared fix can change exactly-once hook ordering across channels.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound hook coverage first while tracking normal-channel `inbound_claim` as a separate API/security item.

options.title: Fold into the broader hook-bypass issue
options.body: Move the Feishu evidence under the existing shared outbound-hook cluster and keep this issue only for Feishu acceptance details.

options.title: Design all hook semantics together
options.body: Use one broader design track for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound hook coverage first while tracking normal-channel `inbound_claim` as a separate API/security item.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved human choice includes `inbound_claim` and plugin conversation-binding authority, which their plugin-surface work most directly touched.
